TRC1-CLOCK-DOMAIN.definition: Compatible(h,c,matter-prefix,geometry) from same source/context and fixed coupled-wave law.

TRC1-BRIDGE-SOURCE-SUPPORT.definition: Named mathematical construction proposes these physical endpoints; gate UNRESOLVED, no lift claimed.

TRC1-BRIDGE-SUPPORT-RECORD.definition: Named mathematical construction proposes these physical endpoints; gate UNRESOLVED, no lift claimed.

TRC1-BRIDGE-OCCURRENCE.definition: Named mathematical construction proposes these physical endpoints; gate UNRESOLVED, no lift claimed.

TRC1-CHOICE-SOURCE-HEAD.definition: Marked first-four balanced coordinates of a pointed head; arbitrary n0 head adapter new, sign independently available from head.

TRC1-CHOICE-SOURCE-INJECTION.definition: Five-site centered S from #823, explicitly norm-exposed to QDD; not physical independence.

TRC1-CHOICE-CONTEXT.definition: Fixed family index(Gamma,q,N) chosen before prediction; no adaptive context or target fit.

TRC1-CHOICE-READY.definition: Singleton cold fresh empty and one unrecycled zero incoming vector per step; finite capacity premise.

TRC1-CHOICE-CLOCK.definition: One cold transition per U provenance update, available n0+t+1; no reset/intertwining/SI claim.

TRC1-CHOICE-RECORD.definition: Full signed tape and before/after snapshots; one accounting record per step and all ordinal crossings atomically.

TRC1-CHOICE-RESET.definition: Reject reset with unchanged state; no conforming #539reset supplied.

TRC1-CHOICE-OBSERVATION.definition: Disjoint MODEL/FOREIGN_NIST plus retained invalid/unresolved evidence; no threshold/detector equivalence.

TRC1-CHOICE-OCCURRENCE.definition: External finite rational source ensemble mu, one initial draw, deterministic complete-state Dirac kernel.

TRC1-CHOICE-NO-BLINDNESS.definition: All prior published and analyzed NIST exposure disclosed; validation partition is separate and frozen.

TRC1-CHOICE-NO-BORN-BOOTSTRAP.definition: No construction of effects or rates from desired QDD targets; normalized energies/counts not physical probabilities.

QDD-ALGEBRAIC-FACTORIZATION.definition: Exact theorem identifier in v76 NORMATIVE.tsv and REGISTRY.tsv.

TRC1-SIGNED4.definition: Four signed integers in {-2,-1,0,1,2}, in marked head-coordinate order.

TRC1-SUPPORT-TAG.definition: Exactly ZERO_SUPPORT or SUPPORTED, the algebraic QDD field.

TRC1-Q-PAIR-NONNEG.definition: Ordered pair(LOW,HIGH) of nonnegative rationals; no swap.

TRC1-DENSITY-TAG.definition: ZERO_DENOMINATOR or DENSITY(M), M a4x4 rational matrix.

TRC1-NORMALIZED-TAG.definition: ZERO_DENOMINATOR or NORMALIZED(a,b), ordered rational pair with a,b>=0,a+b=1.

TRC1-BIT.definition: Integer0 or1; distinct from a Boolean.

TRC1-SOURCE-REF.definition: Immutable full-value reference to TRC1-SOURCE, equality by referenced head.

TRC1-PAIR-REF.definition: Immutable full-value reference to TRC1-PAIR; both complete sparse fields retained.

TRC1-APPARATUS-REF.definition: Immutable full-value reference to TRC1-APPARATUS, including entire signed tape.

TRC1-EVENT-REF.definition: Immutable full-value reference to TRC1-EVENT; never only outcome/heat/hash equality.

TRC1-ENSEMBLE-REF.definition: Immutable full-value reference to TRC1-ENSEMBLE; exact atom heads and probabilities retained.

TRC1-PORT-FIELD.definition: Canonical finite rational map on fixedR, zero entries omitted; absent active sites mean zero.

TRC1-HEAT-FIELD.definition: Canonical nonnegative rational map supported within fixedR; zero entries omitted.

TRC1-COUNT-VECTOR.definition: Lexicographic tuple(site,nonnegative integer) containing every site of fixedR, including zero counts.

TRC1-CROSSINGS.definition: Lexicographic tuple(site,first,last), one interval per crossing site,1<=first<=last; all new ordinals included.

TRC1-OUTCOME-TAG.definition: NO_CROSSINGS iff crossing tuple empty, otherwise THRESHOLD_CROSSINGS; not exclusive LOW/HIGH.

TRC1-TAPE.definition: Ordered finite tuple of TRC1-PORT-FIELD, lengtht for matching apparatus.

TRC1-PAIR-SEQUENCE.definition: Ordered tuple(P0,...,PN) of complete TRC1-PAIR for fixed contextN.

TRC1-ENERGY-SEQUENCE.definition: Ordered tuple(E(P0),...,E(PN)) of nonnegative rational energies.

TRC1-CURRENT-SEQUENCE.definition: Ordered lengthN tuple of finite rational antisymmetric directed D3-edge maps J(u_t,v_t,w_t), using fixed inherited representative.

TRC1-EVENT-SEQUENCE.definition: Ordered tuple of complete immutable EventRecord references, with consecutive ticks and compatible before/after states.

TRC1-MODEL-ORIGIN.definition: Singleton MODEL_RRP1; no foreign apparatus identity.

TRC1-MODEL-IDENTITY.definition: Pair of full source/context references; identifies a logical modeled history, not a physical repeated-run nonce.

TRC1-EVIDENCE-REFS.definition: Singleton ordered tuple containing this complete EventRecord reference for MODEL packets.

TRC1-MODEL-COVERAGE.definition: Singleton MODEL_TRANSITION_COMPLETE; not physical acquisition coverage.

TRC1-CALIBRATION-ABSENCE.definition: Singleton UNRESOLVED tag, explicitly no issued physical calibration reference.

TRC1-MASS-TABLE.definition: Finite table(visible-packet prefix,positive rational mass), zero mass omitted; exact typed lexicographic order; total1.

TRC1-QDD-RECORD.definition: Exact five-field record of DEF-QDD-MATTER-RECORD and direct write; not whole MatterRecord.

TRC1-SUPPORT-DECISION.definition: SUPPORTED(h) with z!=0 or ZERO_SOURCE(h) with z=0; total on valid SOURCE.

TRC1-STEP-OUTPUT.definition: Compatible tuple(outcome,next_pair,next_apparatus,delta) returned by STEP; duplicated references must agree literally.

TRC1-GEOMETRY-STEP.definition: Full pair before/after, outgoingb, energies before/after and inherited current for one coupled step.

TRC1-MATTER-PREFIX.definition: Tuple of MatterRecord at cuts0..N for the same source/context.

TRC1-MODEL-PACKET.definition: Exactly the named record_schema_manifest for TRC1-MODEL-PACKET; coherence equations in maps additionally constrain values.

TRC1-TRANSITION-LAW.definition: Dirac probability table on complete successor state times(VISIBLE packet or END); abstract discrete law, no physical L6 identification.

TRC1-POSTERIOR-RESULT.definition: Normalized finite next-VISIBLE-packet/END mass table, or IMPOSSIBLE_UNDER_FIXED_MODEL for zero conditioning mass.

TRC1-QCARRIER.definition: im((zz^T,zz^T)|V_eff), two separately typed matrix slots as in DEF-QDD-QCARRIER-EQUALITY.

TRC1-QCARRIER-EQ.definition: Ordered componentwise rational matrix equality; the two typed slots remain distinct.

TRC1-QUERY-DOMAIN.definition: Compatible(h,c,t), h valid SOURCE,c fixed CONTEXT,0<=t<=N.

TRC1-READY-DOMAIN.definition: Supported source and the preselected matching context.

TRC1-PREPARE-DOMAIN.definition: Supported source, fixed matching context and singleton cold ready.

TRC1-ZERO-DOMAIN.definition: Valid source with signedz=0 and fixed matching context.

TRC1-WAVE-DOMAIN.definition: Finite-support rational Pair and the fixed matching Context; no heat/count input.

TRC1-STEP-DOMAIN.definition: Coherent complete state matching fixed c, t<N, including pair and entire apparatus/history.

TRC1-PERSIST-DOMAIN.definition: (old apparatus,outcome,event) in the compatible STEP-image: old==event.apparatus_before and outcome matches.

TRC1-APPEND-DOMAIN.definition: Generated History and next Event with matching source/context/tick/pair/apparatus adjacency.

TRC1-FOLD-DOMAIN.definition: Valid SOURCE and fixed CONTEXT; all source heads, including zero.

TRC1-PREDICTION-DOMAIN.definition: (fixed c, finite normalized mu, k),0<=k<=N; all atoms valid SOURCE.

TRC1-POSTERIOR-DOMAIN.definition: Fixed(c,mu) and a VISIBLE packet prefix of lengthk<=N; complete source-atom histories retained.

TRC1-PHYSICAL-DECISION-DOMAIN.definition: Observation with retained evidence and either complete frozen certificates/decision inputs or explicit missing-certificate tags.

TRC1-MODEL-PACKET-EQ.definition: Literal complete nine-field model-packet equality, including full event reference.

TRC1-VISIBLE-PACKET.definition: Product(context_ref,tick,kind,multiplicities,crossing_ranges). kind is NO_CROSSING/SINGLE_CROSSING/MULTIPLE_CROSSINGS; no source head or internal state references. Full packet keeps zero-source distinction, visible projection groups all no-crossing cases.

TRC1-SRC-NIST-ADAPTER.definition: Pinned separate raw-record interval adapter implementation; no physical interpretation or NMC1 wrapper conformance.

TRC1-SRC-NIST-ADAPTER-RESULT.definition: Four declared gates PASS in first pinned Linux run and independent aarch64/x86_64 cold replay; verifier and stdout hashes identical. Finite raw-record partition and observable extraction, no physical lift or Canon promotion.

TRC1-SRC-NMC1-MD.definition: Published NON-CANONICAL NMC1 semantic/certificate wrapper definition; proposed interface, not an implemented wrapper, issued physical certificate or U/RRP1/NIST identity.

TRC1-SRC-NMC1-JSON.definition: Published NON-CANONICAL NMC1 semantic/certificate wrapper definition; proposed interface, not an implemented wrapper, issued physical certificate or U/RRP1/NIST identity.
